title: Hard market indicators and demand signals will make shortlisted opportunities more credible by showing which themes carry the strongest investor pull
subtitle: Illustrative ranking of market and demand signals to support investor consideration, showing that opportunities gain credibility when IFC anchors them in visible demand, trade, and offtake evidence rather than narrative alone.

chart.annotation: Demand-backed indicators rank highest, making investor-ready opportunities more credible than broad sector claims alone.

insights.text: **Import substitution demand** leads at **92**, followed by **Export market access** at **86** and **Anchor offtake visibility** at **81**, showing the strongest proof points sit closest to observable demand.
**Indian strategic fit** at **77** remains important, but it ranks below direct market signals such as demand, access, and offtake evidence.

Lower-ranked indicators, including **Price competitiveness** at **69** and **Policy support strength** at **63**, still matter but do less on their own to convert investor interest into opportunity screening.
